Created `/workspace/middleware.ts`.

It generates a UUID via `crypto.randomUUID()`, logs `[<<id>] <pathname>` to the console, and attaches it to the response header `X-Request-Id`. The matcher excludes static assets and API routes by default.

Created `/workspace/middleware.ts`.

It generates a UUID via `crypto.randomUUID()`, logs `[<<id>] <pathname>` to the console, and attaches it to the response header `X-Request-Id`. The matcher excludes static assets and API routes by default.
